event: Ice-rock avalanche collapses into the Lhende Khola in Tibet, damming it with ice and debris
River gauge destroyed as the temporary dam fails and the surge is released
Official warning issued -- 38 minutes after the collapse
Surge travels Lhende Khola to Bhote Koshi to Trishuli to Narayani, over 100 km downstream
Rasuwagadhi border crossing, Timure and Syabrubesi destroyed
